children: Millrose Properties announced two material contract amendments. The company refined its Founder’s Rights Agreement with Lennar, adjusting how the Priority Amount is calculated for the Capital Priority Right and updating secured financing collateral consent provisions. Separately, Millrose amended its Management Agreement with Kennedy Lewis Land and Residential Advisors to update investment guidelines and the definition of reimbursable expenses. The changes aim to tighten governance with a key strategic partner and improve oversight and cost transparency with its external manager.
